about: Quote bank for @suksesishqip. Popularity = Goodreads likes (checked 2026-11-09). Only quotes believed to be genuinely in the named book. 'paraphrase': true means common wording is a paraphrase of the translation: present it as 'sipas' (according to) the author, not as an exact quote. Translate into Albanian at posting time and mark as 'përkthim i lirë'. Mark 'used' with the date after posting.

banned.quote: Everything we hear is an opinion, not a fact. Everything we see is a perspective, not the truth.
banned.reason: Widely attributed to Marcus Aurelius but not in Meditations.

banned.quote: The love of money is the root of all evil.
banned.reason: Bible (1 Timothy 6:10), only quoted in Rich Dad Poor Dad.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: The soul becomes dyed with the colour of its thoughts.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.quote: It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.

quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.quote: Until we have begun to go without them, we fail to realize how unnecessary many things are.

quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.author: Robert Greene

quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki
